name: Valheim

nativeLaunch.help: Valheim runs its Linux version here, and BepInEx (the mod loader) starts through a script that comes with it. Steam only runs that script when you ask it to: in Steam, open Valheim's Properties, and under Launch Options type exactly the line below. You only do this once. Without it, the game starts without mods.

notes: Steam ships a native Linux build; its BepInEx pack starts through start_game_bepinex.sh there, and through winhttp.dll under Proton. The pack holds both, so detection is the same.
The pack's start_game_bepinex.sh starts the game with BepInEx (Doorstop) loaded; Steam only runs it when the Launch Option points at it.
